_note: Live data for the Connections dashboard. Refreshed weekly (Tue 7am) by the Connections refresh job, which pulls PCO list counts + the Google Sheet attendance, overwrites this file, then runs build_connections.py. Attendance = weekly (from the Sheet); PCO roster/groups/serving/guests = as of the close of the previous month.

attendance._source: Google Sheet '2026' tab, weekly total attendance (col B). weekend = latest week; moving_avg_6wk, avg_weekly_ytd, avg_weekly_prev_month computed in the renderer.

pco._source: Planning Center saved Lists (People). Counts are point-in-time; the monthly-refresh lists reflect the close of the previous month.

flags.baptisms: PCO 'Baptisms' list (Baptism y/n = Yes) returns only 3 and was last refreshed in 2021 — not a maintained source. Shown as not tracked until a real source is chosen.
flags.connect_breakfast: PCO 'Connect Breakfast' list is currently empty (0). Shown as not tracked until repopulated or another source is chosen.
flags.starting_point: Pulled from PCO 'Starting Point Attendance' list (22) as a fallback; a Starting Point column was not found on the Google Sheet.
